title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00101 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Broke connection, dropped ball, RIH to firing depth. Perforated interval 141m 147,4m
00:15 - 00:30: Closed BOP, lined via fully open choke, pressured up string to 135 bar, observed shear
00:30 - 01:15: Circulated via poor boy to check for gas with 250 LPM, 1 bar. Pumped 2. 3m3 to get stable returns
01:15 - 01:45: Flow check via choke
01:45 - 02:15: Opened BOP, lined up and flow checked on trip tank, well static
02:15 - 02:45: POOH from 148 m to 16m
02:45 - 03:15: Inspected and layed down BHA. All shots fired
03:15 - 03:30: Change handling gear back to 5. 5 elevators and iron roughneck
03:30 - 03:45: R/d perforation handling equipment and cleared rig floor.
03:45 - 04:00: Pickup milling BHA from cantilever, RIH from surface to 5m
04:00 - 04:15: Performed pre-job meeting for handling milling BHA and rig tongs
04:15 - 05:15: R/u tongs and m/u magnet to 68knm
05:15 - 05:30: R/d rig tongs
05:30 - 07:00: Continued p/u milling BHA
07:00 - 07:15: M/u TDS and fill pipe
07:15 - 07:30: Recorded parameters 2000lts/ min 5-7 bar. Up WT. 78t, down WT. 74t without rotation, free rotation torque with 80 RPM, 0-3 KNM, rotating weight 76t. Run in and tagged at 140. 86m bit depth
07:30 - 15:30: Pulled up 1. 5m, established parameters and commenced milling. 2000lts/ min 5-7 bar, 80 RPM, 2-4 KNM, wob 1. 3t. Milled from 141. 26m to 141. 46m. Picked off bttm and spaced out due to leaking fittings on BOP
15:30 - 18:00: Repaired leaking fitting on BOP
18:00 - 19:00: Lineed up and started milling from 141. 06m to 141. 07m, 2000 LPM, 5 bar, 120 RPM, 5-15 KNM
19:00 - 22:30: Continued milling 100-120rpm, 1-3t wob, 2000lpm, 3-11knm, 5-7bar. Stopped due to no progress
22:30 - 23:45: Attempted to r/b DP stand, no success. Observed connection above saver sub broke when trying to break out stand from TDS
23:45 - 00:00: R/b stand of DP with saver sub. Broke connection with 150knm
